descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you a driven sales leader with deep market expertise? We are seeking a Franchise Sales Director to join our Global Markets team in Toronto.

In this role, you will:
• Deliver UBS’s equity franchise and build strategic client relationships
• Share high value trade ideas, actionable market color and investment ideas with institutional investors
• Partner with trading desks for efficient execution
• Collaborate across divisions to provide integrated solutions
• Advise clients on global equity markets and trends
• Drive revenue through client engagement and uphold compliance standards
• Manage senior relationships with the largest Canadian institutions
• Act as primary point of contact across equity products and services
